comments.text: This is a great interview with lots of insight. As a Patent attorney myself, I agree with everything he said…but I almost never look at Examiner statistics. My assessment of how to respond to an office action is almost solely dictated by the quality of the rejection and whether I believe the inventor deserves a patent based on the quality of his invention. To me a good patent attorney will understand the novelty of the invention better than the inventor and know how best to argue the merits.
